name: flexipos/host
description: FlexiPOS module host: boots the modules named in the MODULES environment variable.

scripts-descriptions.setup: Install dependencies, create .env, generate a key and migrate.
scripts-descriptions.dev: Serve the host. The queue worker and the log tailer are their own commands now (artisan queue:listen, artisan pail): multiplexing them needed npx concurrently, and T-004 removed the front-end build this host never had.
scripts-descriptions.lint: Check formatting with Pint (no files changed).
scripts-descriptions.deptrac: Enforce module/package boundary rules with Deptrac.
scripts-descriptions.test: Run the Pest suite through tools/gate-step.php, so the step owns its own timer instead of borrowing the package manager's: a kill prints FLEXIPOS-GATE-TIMEOUT and exits 3, and a completed run ends with FLEXIPOS-GATE-MARGIN. Every line names which limit was in force. The limit itself, the dated cache-cold measurement it is derived from and the command that re-measures it all live in extra.flexipos.gate - one authority, and nothing else repeats the number.
scripts-descriptions.test:fast: Inner development loop only: the whole suite except the toolchain group (the tests that spawn a child process to boot a whole tool). Never the gate - use check.
scripts-descriptions.test:slow: Only the toolchain group, so the split can be proved by count and by name.
scripts-descriptions.engine:clean: Report, and never drop, any reserved test database (prefix flexipos_t8test_) a killed engine run left behind: it lists them and exits 0. First in check, beside probes:clean, and for the same measured reason: check runs lint, stan and deptrac before any test, so nothing driven from a test hook ever runs ahead of the steps a leftover breaks. It enumerates information_schema and filters in PHP - SQL LIKE is forbidden, because `_` is a single-character wildcard there and SHOW DATABASES LIKE 'flexipos_%' returns the owner's real flexipos-master. It honours ENGINE_HOLD, so under the hold it opens no connection at all. The sweep it used to perform was deleted on 2026-10-14, after a permissive stub of the name guard turned that shape of sweep into sixteen dropped databases: EngineDatabase::recreate() already drops the one name it is about to create, so the sweep bought nothing, and no file but EngineDatabase may issue a database drop (enforced by tests/Feature/DestructiveStatementContainmentTest.php).
scripts-descriptions.probes:clean: Delete any probe a killed run left behind. Each carries a deliberate defect, so a survivor aborts stan or deptrac before any test hook could remove it - which is why this runs first in check, not from a test.
scripts-descriptions.check: Run probes:clean, engine:clean, lint, stan, deptrac and test in sequence (CI gate).

gate.cache-cold-slowest-step-seconds-provenan: 2026-11-05, lead (ported from T-020's own FP-328 fix, ai/T-020-workflow-engine commits bb52ac3/3e0e9cd/2fb3a2b/b122ffc, before this branch was rebased onto T-020's final tip). The slowest step is no longer a cold-cache toolchain step (the original 106s figure): it is now the `test` step itself, at 1232.06s warm, measured with COMPOSER_PROCESS_TIMEOUT=2400 after the gate's own 900s limit killed the step outright (FLEXIPOS-GATE-TIMEOUT, elapsed=883.42s, no result produced). Test-suite growth across T-016 through T-020 is the cause, not toolchain cache state - this field's name now undersells what it measures, but is kept for continuity with `remeasure-with` below, and with GateStepTimerTest's AC-2 formula (limit >= headroom-factor x machine-cold-factor x this value), which is still read against this field regardless of what actually made it the slowest.
gate.machine-cold-factor-provenance: D-12, rounded up from the session's first whole-gate run at 240.87s [state: MACHINE-COLD] against 87.34s [state: WARM], 2026-10-07, dev. A whole-gate figure, not a per-process one, which is why it is a factor here and not a duration: machine-cold-slowest-step-seconds stays null until someone measures one step that way.
gate.measured-by: lead, autonomous T-020 close-out (FP-328 escalated from a low-headroom warning to an actual FLEXIPOS-GATE-TIMEOUT); ported onto this branch the same day
gate.remeasure-with: in modules/host: delete storage/framework/cache/phpstan and storage/framework/cache/.deptrac.cache, then time each of composer probes:clean, composer lint, composer stan, composer deptrac and composer test, and take the largest wall time. As of 2026-11-05 that is always `test`, and its growth with the suite - not toolchain cache state - is the real constraint; consider splitting the test step (e.g. toolchain group already runs separately) before raising this limit again. The shipped limit must clear headroom-factor x machine-cold-factor x cache-cold-slowest-step-seconds (GateStepTimerTest enforces this as AC-2) - 2 x 3 x 1232 = 7392. GateStepTimerTest actually asserts this against the *budget* (limit minus the reserve of max(2, ceil(limit * 0.02))), not the raw limit, so the limit needs slack to absorb that reserve too - 7500 left a budget of 7350, 42 short; 7600 cleared the budget (7448) but was not a multiple of 300, a separate structural check the same test enforces. 7800 clears all three constraints, leaving a budget of 7644.
